versions.content: Selection/binding of the configuration variant The EcuM will determine (via a call t o EcuM_DeterminePbConfiguration()) which of these post - build time configuration variants shall be used. Based on the used configuration variant, the EcuM will then call the BSW modules’ initialization functions (SWS_BSW_00050, SWS_BSW_00150) with a pointer to the appropriate post - build configuration variant for the particular BSW module.
